q: What is AsquareB Knowledge Orbit?
a:
AsquareB Knowledge Orbit Private Limited is a comprehensive education and career development organization committed to empowering learners through quality education, career guidance, technology training, and skill development.

We provide a complete educational ecosystem that supports students from their early school years through higher education and professional careers. Our services include academic coaching, career counselling, educational consultancy, entrance examination coaching, distance education, vocational programs, student development initiatives, and technology-focused learning.

At AsquareB, we believe education is more than achieving good marks. Our goal is to help every learner discover their potential, develop confidence, build practical skills, and prepare for lifelong success.

"Empowering Learners. Shaping Careers. Transforming Futures."

q: What is NIOS?
a:
The National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) is an open schooling system that offers flexible education opportunities for learners who cannot pursue regular schooling or who prefer an alternative mode of education.

NIOS provides Secondary (equivalent to Class 10) and Senior Secondary (equivalent to Class
12) programs, along with vocational and other educational opportunities.

q: Who should choose NIOS?

• Students requiring flexible learning
• Students who need an alternative education pathway
• Learners preparing for competitive exams alongside school education
